user.title: Welcome to Family Hub
user.description: Set up your family's task manager. You can change these settings later from the admin dashboard.

add_parent.title: Add a parent
add_parent.description: Add at least one parent account. You can add a second parent and link HA user accounts from the admin dashboard later.

add_kids.title: Add your kids
add_kids.description: Enter your kids' names separated by commas. You can add or edit people later from the admin dashboard.

abort.already_configured: Family Hub is already set up. Use the admin dashboard to make changes.

init.title: Modules
init.description: Turn Family Hub modules on or off. A disabled module registers no services or sensors and its room shows as unavailable on the Command Center. Its data is kept and restored when you re-enable it.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Mark a task as complete. Awards points immediately if self-reported, or queues for parent approval.

claim_task.name: Claim task
claim_task.description: Claim an unclaimed task from the claimable pool.

approve_task.name: Approve task
approve_task.description: Approve a completed task and award points to the completer.

deny_task.name: Deny task
deny_task.description: Deny a completed task. No points are awarded.

add_one_time_task.name: Add one-time task
add_one_time_task.description: Quickly add a one-off task for anyone.

add_chore.name: Add chore
add_chore.description: Add a recurring chore with full recurrence configuration.

delete_chore.name: Delete chore
delete_chore.description: Deactivate a chore and remove its pending task instances.

request_redemption.name: Request redemption
request_redemption.description: Request to spend points on a store item. Requires parent approval.

approve_redemption.name: Approve redemption
approve_redemption.description: Approve a store redemption request and deduct points.

decline_redemption.name: Decline redemption
decline_redemption.description: Decline a store redemption request. No points are deducted.

add_store_item.name: Add store item
add_store_item.description: Add a reward item to the store.

award_bonus_points.name: Award bonus points
award_bonus_points.description: Award bonus points to a family member for any reason.

export_backup.name: Export backup
export_backup.description: Save a timestamped backup of all Family Hub data.
